versions.content: Recursive definition of a primitive data type An Autosar- DataType is considered a primitive data type if the following conditions apply: • it is an AutosarDataType according to [TPS_SWCT_01564] • it is an AutosarDataType of category TYPE_REFERENCE that, after all type- references have been resolved, boils down an AutosarDataType according to [TPS_SWCT_01564].
